findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "proxy (unresolved DOM association)" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0.15s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and "github.com/DeezGit21/jarvis-deck" renders at 26 px for 2.99 s: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.

The film's last line "music: "Mechanolith" — Kevin MacLeod, incompetech.com · l..." (12 words) is on screen 2.76 s (±0.01 s), under the 3.07 s a closing line needs: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word and at least 2 s before the film ends; see references/motion.md.
